name: SPA learned future-action comparisons v1
question: Can the native267parameter SPA policy acquire a choice from measured future consequences and select useful actions on new sentence states?

body.architecture: 128-wide, two-layer, four-head RoPE/RMSNorm/SwiGLU transformer; hidden 384; 94 Unicode characters; context 64
body.numerical_engine: upstream notorch.c linked with the independent C experiment runner

source_exposure.training: All scenario states and H0/H1/H4 outcomes for seeds42/73 are already inspected and retained from the preceding experiment.
source_exposure.evaluation: Sentence-scenario seeds101/211 have not been generated or inspected before this protocol. The same frozen checkpoint and corpus are used.
source_exposure.known_training_structure: At H4 all12 target3 training states have identical complete after-chains and seven after-axes across valid initial actions. Fixed continuation overwrites their initial intervention before reading it; generation cost differs. Report each target position separately.

training.order: Seed42 snapshot0..23, then seed73 snapshot0..23, repeated in the same order every epoch.
training.other_config: nt_spa_agent_config_default unchanged, including raw reward coefficients and costweight.
training.initialization: Each arm starts from the same canonical newly initialized life. Its online history,counters and RNG remain unchanged during replay; captured source features carry the original sentence/action history.
training.initial_arm: Saved before fitting and never fitted.
training.target: For each valid action: frozen raw-component reward(action,horizon) minus reward(KEEP,same horizon); KEEP target0.
training.objective: Mean Huber loss with delta1 across all and only valid action heads. Compute all head/hidden gradients from one pre-update policy; SGD rate0.03, existing parameter bounds[-8,8].

shuffle.group: Identical(sentence_count,target index), preserving typed action coordinates and mask.
shuffle.order: Original global training row order within each group.
shuffle.donor: The next row in the group with cyclic wraparound: donor_index=(receiver_index+1)mod group_size.
shuffle.transform: Keep receiver features and feature-source identity; copy the donor fullH4 raw comparison and bind its training-input source field to the receiver. Record the actual donor outcome-source identity separately. Original measured records remain unchanged.
shuffle.question: Does correct association of a sentence state with its future outcomes improve selection beyond acquired action preferences?

training.h0_control_question: Does using the later consequence improve H4 selection compared with the same budget fitted to immediate outcomes?
training.no_adaptation: No changes to target,horizon,rate,epoch count,ordering,capacity or body recipe after experiment fitting/evaluation begins.

evaluation.seal_before_generation: Write and hash initial/H4/H0/shuffled lives, complete training trace and source/protocol identities before starting any101/211 body process. Recheck that seal before and after evaluation.
evaluation.state_source: Unchanged spa_agent_demo learned-arm ordinary trajectory with diagnostics enabled. The policy under evaluation reads captured features; the reference host retains its existing online behavior.

generation.initial_prompt_selection: SplitMix64 samples the sorted corpus sentence-start offsets (first character and the character after .!? followed by whitespace); choose 16 following codepoints.
generation.base_chain: Generate the complete four-sentence chain once per episode and seed; clone it into every arm before intervention. Store every generated token and termination flag.
generation.rng: Independent SplitMix64 generation stream per episode/slot. Reseeds use the same per-seed/episode/decision stream in every arm. Policy RNG is separate.

evaluation.intervention_rng: stream(seed, 0x7370615f6163746e, episode_index, decision_index), exactly the parent host stream. All alternatives start from this identical stream; KEEP consumes none.

continuation.horizon_meaning: Number of additional fixed host reseeds after the initial intervention; horizon 0 is its immediate consequence.
continuation.future_action: RESEED_LEFT if future_target>0; otherwise RESEED_RIGHT. This is a frozen diagnostic host continuation and performs no agent learning.
continuation.future_host_rng: stream(seed, 0x7370615f66757472, episode_index*4 + decision_index, hop), independently constructed at every hop and identical across initial alternatives.
continuation.generation: The same parent 3-character-neighbor, min 12/max 64, temperature 0.8 recipe at every hop.

evaluation.readout: Native C pure greedy score_experience on identical29feature values for all four saved lives. Same boundary mask and KEEP-first exact score ties. No readout learning or RNG/history mutation.
evaluation.execution_association: Join each native typed choice to that source state's actually executed alternative branch and complete raw measured trajectory. Retain both source identity and selected outcome-record identity.
evaluation.paired_host_gate: For each new seed run ordinary diagnosticsOFF andON; require complete byte-identical ordinary JSONL and all five saved lives. Complete scenario stream must contain24snapshots60forks180measurements.

measurements.target: Seven metrics always refer to the original intervention target index in the current four-sentence chain, including at later horizons.
measurements.before: Snapshot metrics before any intervention, shared by every action/horizon.

axes.local_connectedness: Mean cosine similarity of target to its existing immediate neighbors, mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1].
axes.global_connectedness: Unchanged nt_spa_connectedness of target against all other sentence embeddings.
axes.coherence: Mean adjacent sentence cosine similarity mapped to [0,1].
axes.novelty: 1 minus maximum positive cosine similarity between target and any other sentence.
axes.repetition: Repeated character trigrams inside target divided by all target trigrams; zero for fewer than three tokens.
axes.collapse: Fraction of the six unordered sentence pairs with cosine similarity at least 0.98.
axes.continuity: Minimum adjacent sentence cosine similarity mapped to [0,1].

measurements.cost: cumulative_generated_characters / (64 * (horizon+1)); include initial intervention and all fixed continuation generations. KEEP initial cost is 0.
measurements.cost_reporting: Retain initial generated chars, each future generated chars, cumulative chars, and the declared horizon denominator independently of reward.
measurements.interpretation: The later-horizon score measures this fixed continuation and its normalized generation cost. The parent policy continues learning exclusively from its original immediate reward; diagnostic measurements never train it.

primary_metrics: Mean selected reward minus same-state KEEP reward.
Mean regret=max valid measured reward minus selected measured reward.
Counts of KEEP/LEFT/RIGHT and selections within1e-7of measured best reward.
Changed typed choices between initial and H4 weights on identical capturedfeatures.
comparisons: All saved policies vs each fixedKEEP/LEFT/RIGHT preference
reporting.raw_components: Retain every selected and alternative action's seven before/after axes,normalized generation cost,raw character counts,complete tokens and termination flags atH0/H1/H4.
secondary: H0 outcomes under each learned choice
H1 outcomes under each learned choice
Per-epoch loss and every native comparison-fit receipt with source/donor identity and pre/post scores
reporting.reproducibility: Two complete identical training/evaluation executions; compare dataset,all saved lives,complete fit/readout and body/scenario streams byte for byte. Retain one canonical compressed trace set and both artifact manifests.
reporting.artifacts: No modelweights,agentcheckpoint or executable committed. Retain source/compiler/model/corpus/protocol identities, commands,outcomes,rawcompressed traces,fit/readout receipts and sealed-life hashes.
reporting.result_policy: Keep all recorded positive,zero and negative outcomes under this frozen measurement.

core: All valid action masks and boundary coordinates
Output/input aliases refused or safely copied as documented
Replay changes policy only; pending refuses replay
Save/resume reproduces fit continuation and readout
Existing v1 initial,pending,completed and imitation life bytes match rebuilt base
causal: Compiled immediate/future substitution caught by actual reversal fixture
Compiled credit-sign or action-target swap caught
Undeclared source-feature reassociation refused by dataset/association gate
Pure readout choices independent of supplied outcome values
host: Raw rewards independently recomputed from all axes and cost
Unchanged complete ordinaryOFF/ON traces and lives
Only declared shuffle mapping permits donor reassignment
All four lives sealed before new-seed process and unchanged afterward
Native chosen-action receipt joins exact executed branch
Complete artifacts rehashed and revalidated after a later read

scope.new_primitive: Native comparison replay and pure captured-experience readout above existing SPA.
scope.old_behavior: Ordinary SPA perception,online observe arithmetic,canonical lifeformat and prior protocols/receipts remain unchanged.
scope.territory: Independent SPAfiles. Chuck code and branches remain read-only references. Root owns shared Makefile,README and log wiring.
scope.next_body: This phase uses the existing cheap SimpleLLM body.
